g.text: 5 V buck PER DISC (base-fed 5 V loses a fifth in the riser); white strings 5s at 3.2 V worst-bin Vf under the 20 V floor.

g.desc: 5 V buck PER DISC (base-fed 5 V loses a fifth in the riser); white strings 5s at 3.2 V worst-bin Vf under the 20 V floor.

g.text: Per disc [I]: white 4.80 W + pixels 5.12 W = 11.67 W at the bus; four discs + base = 48.6 W per post.

g.desc: Per disc [I]: white 4.80 W + pixels 5.12 W = 11.67 W at the bus; four discs + base = 48.6 W per post.

g.text: Pin numbers are hidden on parts whose package pinout has NOT been transcribed. Only the 74AHCT125 and the OPT4048 have earned theirs.

g.desc: Pin numbers are hidden on parts whose package pinout has NOT been transcribed. Only the 74AHCT125 and the OPT4048 have earned theirs.

g.text: Disc is 70 mm through a 101.6 mm globe mount ID [M operator, corrected 2026-08-02].

g.desc: Disc is 70 mm through a 101.6 mm globe mount ID [M operator, corrected 2026-08-02].

g.text: Same ten emitters, same 4.80 W — the second driver buys colour temperature.

g.desc: Same ten emitters, same 4.80 W — the second driver buys colour temperature.

g.text: TWO white channels: 2200 K on U1, 3000 K on U3, 5s at 0.15 A each.

g.desc: TWO white channels: 2200 K on U1, 3000 K on U3, 5s at 0.15 A each.

g.text: U5 reads the sky THROUGH the globe (TI: characterized under dark cover glass), and only while every emitter is blanked.

g.desc: U5 reads the sky THROUGH the globe (TI: characterized under dark cover glass), and only while every emitter is blanked.

g.text: The globe has to breathe: vent + weep + coating are the defences; U4 is how anyone knows they work (orb_climate.py).

g.desc: The globe has to breathe: vent + weep + coating are the defences; U4 is how anyone knows they work (orb_climate.py).

g.text: 16 pixels, ONE chain. WLED's four "segments" are software divisions of this single chain — one per sphere — not four wires.
